title: Tokenizer keeps state in a global (c)
description: The code splits a string with strtok, which stores the cursor in global state. A nested or concurrent parse silently resumes somebody else's string and the two parses interleave.
remediation: Use the reentrant variant with an explicit cursor, for example the reentrant tokenizer with an explicit cursor.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the call without proving nesting or concurrency.
